turns.speaker: them
turns.text: I'll be happy to take whatever you can spare, but it is not a priority of mine, given the local supply you mentioned.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: How much firewood is available. I would prefer 3 packages if I am giving up 2 food packages.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Could you possibly leave me with one package of firewood?  I might want to stay up late and sing songs around the fire.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: I would give you all the water if I could have all firewood. I would keep 1 food and give you two.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Alright, I think that sounds pretty fair.  All our needs would be met.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: You can cut down some trees for your fire haha.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Maybe I'll just bring a pair of night vision goggles.  🙂

reasons: I have recently eaten and can get by eating small portions.
There are sources of water around the site.
I am low on supplies and it is very cold.
I may do additional hiking if additional calories are available.
I may need this because I come across a thirsty animal or if I get diarrhea.
I may intend to do more activities at night if I have more light from the firewood.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Hello, I'm very excited for my trip, how about you?🙂

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Hello! I'm just packing up now, just waiting for some extra stuff and I'll be ready!

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Awesome, I'm going to have a larger group with me, I would really appreciate getting the extra food, you are welcome to any amount of the wood and water.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: I'd be willing to give you all three food in exchange for what I need. I need water and firewood. I'll be camping in the desert and there's no water supply and it gets quite cold at night!

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Great, I would need a little extra water though for a larger group. Would 3 food, no wood and 1 water for me work for you?

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Hmm. I'd be more willing to give up some firewood than water. Would you take 1 firewood instead?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Sure, I could do that. So 3 food, 1 fire and 0 water for me, the rest for you.🙂

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: That sounds good to me!

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: great, looks like we are all set, enjoy your trip!

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: You too! I'm glad we were able to make a deal

reasons: Not many food sources need to bring snacks
Camping in the desert with no water supply
Cold at night in desert so I need warmth
Don't want to be hungry, no stores around to shop at.
Always need water to stay hydrated, feeling good.
To have a longer campfire.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Hi. I am pretty excited to take my son and his friends camping. They have so much energy

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Hey, I am also going camping but I am taking my 3 kids 🙂

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Between us we have our hands full.🙂 So I am hoping to be able to score 3 food units and 2 waters. What are your needs?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: I can work with that but is there any way I can get 2 waters instead of just 1? There's nowhere to shower here

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Oh sure! I am okay with a jump in the river if it is not too cold! I need at least one firewood because I love to sew before bed but I need the light!

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: That is fine. I can give up 1 firewood. Any way I can get 1 food?

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: We really do need food because teens.🙂🙂 But how about I give you 1 food and 1 firewood? Oh. That's what you just said! Great minds think alike.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: I'll just take 2 firewood 2 water if that's OK

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Oh well, I guess so. ☹️ I will probably fall asleep early anyway. 🙂 When are you leaving for your camp adventure?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: In about 30 minutes actually. Gotta get going so we can get there before noon

reasons: Teenage campers are active and burn calories.
We will all be working up a sweat and need replenisment.
Sewing at night calms me so I need light
I've brought a ton of food and have it in my cooler.
I need some water to wash myself with as there is no shower.
I need it to cook my food and to keep warm at night.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: I think I need more water because I take medicine and it gives me dry mouth. So I think I should have 2 more waters, 2 more food packages and 2 more firewoods. I'm not the best at camping. And I need all the help I can get.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Hello! I totally get it. But, since my nephew will be joinging me on this trip, I won't be able to spar that much.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: I completely understand. But since you're taking your nephew, you must be confident in this camping trip. Whereas I am not. I'm new to this. So I really do need those supplies. I don't know how to hunt or fish. I'm sure you'll understand.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: I am a bit used to camping and that is why i prefer to bring extra food for two. Just in case the wildlife there isn't abudant.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: That's a good idea. 🙂 So since you already have extra I think my offer is pretty good.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Okay, how about this. You get 3 firewood, 2 water. I get alll food, 1 water?

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: That actually sounds pretty good all but the water. I need that extra water. So how about I agree to 2 firewoods, I''ll take you up on all the food since that may be a problem for me but I still need all of the waters.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Thats sound fine

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Ok. Great.🙂 So just to verify I'll have 3 waters, 2 firewoods and 3 food packages.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Nope. I get the 3 food items.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Yes that's right. sorry about that. you get 3 foods and 1 firewood. and i get 3 waters and 2 firewoods.

turns.speaker: you
turns.text: Yep, that's it.

turns.speaker: them
turns.text: Glad that's settled. Hope you all have a good trip.

reasons: My really want to bring my young nephew on his first camp trip and kids can eat everything in sight if you let them.
I google the weather and its going to blazing hot while we're camping. Water is a going to be a live safer.
I want to give my nephew the full camping experience so extra firewood for teachable moments would help.
Food won't last long. And I'm not good at hunting or fishing so I'll need more food as well.
Water will be the first thing to run out and I take medicine, I have dry mouth a lot. So I'm going to need more water.
I'm not a camper though I enjoy it, So I will need more firewood. otherwise I will be cold.
